statement: Recommend-and-proceed: no ritual questions, no permission-seeking for decisions derivable from context.
why: Owner repeatedly rejects ceremony; wants momentum with visible reasoning.
howToApply: Pick the obvious option, state it in one line, proceed.

statement: coordination_init re-init threw raw EEXIST; init must be idempotent.
why: Idempotent init avoids treating a re-run as a filesystem error.
howToApply: Return existing identity, not a filesystem error, on re-init.

statement: enforcer-memory ships zero-network by default; embeddings are an opt-in feature seam.
why: Tests and CI must never require a model download.
howToApply: Gate any embedding retriever behind the embeddings feature.
